description: Whether a product can reach a destination and the dates it can arrive: free Standard, and any paid faster speed that beats it. Give the ZIP for the exact dates. Orders placed by 10am ET on a business day ship the same day from California, and the trays from New York ship the same day if ordered by 1pm ET. Standard shipping is free in the United States. Paid 2-Day and Overnight are offered for a ZIP when they arrive sooner than free Standard. Ordered now, with no ZIP yet: Overnight can arrive as soon as Tue, Dec 1 (2026-12-01), free Standard by Mon, Dec 7 (2026-12-07). For the real date to an address, call check_delivery with the recipient's ZIP.

product_key.description: A product id or slug from search_gifts.

requested_date.description: The date it must arrive by, YYYY-MM-DD.

zip.description: Recipient 5-digit ZIP code, for the exact dates the cart would show.
